title: Installing and Using Claude Code
content:
To install and use Claude Code, follow these steps:
1. When you reopen Cloud Desktop, you'll see the Cloud logo. This opens a pane for the terminal experience, which works alongside you.
2. On Cloud Desktop, you can run Cloud Code. After installation and signing in, a toggle at the top with 'code' will appear, similar to the Claude chat side. It allows you to work in a specific folder, change permissions, and work in a cloud environment.
3. On the web, you can access Claude Code by going to claude.ai/code. This works similarly to the desktop app.
4. However, you are restricted to GitHub repositories only.
5. For the fastest updates, the terminal is the best option. Features are shipped there the fastest. For most IDE integrations, the experiences are extremely similar whether using the IDE or the terminal.
